text: In Alphabet Inc.'s 2026 proxy statement, the 'Other > 5% Security Holders' table lists only BlackRock, Inc., with 6.1% of Class A common stock (2.5% of total voting power); co-founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin hold 46.5% and 42.9% of Class B common stock, representing 27.4% and 25.3% of total voting power. The proxy notes Vanguard disaggregated its holdings reporting in January 2026 and that Alphabet does not know whether any single Vanguard subsidiary exceeds 5%.
short: Alphabet's 2026 proxy lists BlackRock (6.1% of Class A) as its only >5% outside holder; founders control the Class B votes.

source.name: Alphabet Inc. 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR)
